name: Remix: Feel Again - Strategic Visualizer new
description: FeeL Again is a digital infrastructure program showcasing a 'humanitarian fintech' model for MHPSS in Ukraine. It focuses on localization (targeting 70% of aid), radical transparency via a de-identified registry, and measurable economic impact (GDP preservation). The platform acts as a 'digital backbone' connecting global resources with local private-sector capacity through smart contracts and clinical verification.
